title: Phosphorylation of S11 in PHR1 negatively controls its transcriptional activity.
authors: Trejo-Fregoso, Ricardo; Rodriguez, Ivan; Avila, Alejandra; Juarez-Diaz, Javier Andres; Rodriguez-Sotres, Rogelio; Martinez-Barajas, Eleazar; Coello, Patricia
one_liner_zh: 该文研究SnRK1激酶磷酸化PHR1转录因子S11位点对其转录活性的负调控，涉及蛋白-DNA结合（EMSA）与分子对接模拟，但核心是磷酸化调控而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法上仅含简单对接，AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: Plant responses to phosphate starvation (-Pi) are very well characterized at the biochemical and molecular levels. The expression of thousands of genes is modified under this stress condition, depending on the action of Phosphate starvation response 1 (PHR1). Existing data indicate that neither the PHR1 transcript nor the quantity or localization of its protein increase during nutrient stress, raising the question of how its activity is regulated. Here, we present data showing that SnRK1 kinase is able to phosphorylate some phosphate starvation response proteins (PSRs), including PHR1. Based on a model of the three-dimensional structure of the catalytic subunit SnRK1alpha1, docking simulations predicted the binding modes of peptides from PHT1;8, PHO1 and PHR1 with SnRK1. PHR1 recombinant protein interacted in vitro with the catalytic subunits SnRK1alpha1 and SnRK1alpha2. A BiFC assay corroborated the in vivo interaction between PHR1 and SnRK1alpha1 in the cytoplasm and nucleus. Analysis of phosphorylated residues suggested the presence of one phosphorylated site containing the SnRK1 motif at S11, and mutation in this residue disrupted the incorporation of (32) P, suggesting that it is a major phosphorylation site. Electrophoretic mobility shift assay results indicated that the binding of PHR1 to P1BS motifs was not influenced by phosphorylation. Importantly, transient expression assays in Arabidopsis protoplasts showed a decrease in PHR1 activity in contrast with the S11A mutant, suggesting a role for Ser11 as a negative regulatory phosphorylation site. Taken together, these findings suggest that phosphorylation of PHR1 at Ser11 is a mechanism to control the PHR1-mediated adaptive response to -Pi.
abstract_zh: 植物对磷酸盐饥饿（-Pi）的反应在生化和分子水平上已被充分表征。在这种胁迫条件下，数千个基因的表达发生改变，这依赖于磷酸盐饥饿反应因子1（PHR1）的作用。现有数据表明，在营养胁迫期间，PHR1的转录本及其蛋白的数量或定位均未增加，这引发了关于其活性如何被调控的问题。在此，我们提供的数据显示，SnRK1激酶能够磷酸化一些磷酸盐饥饿反应蛋白（PSRs），包括PHR1。基于催化亚基SnRK1alpha1的三维结构模型，对接模拟预测了来自PHT1;8、PHO1和PHR1的肽段与SnRK1的结合模式。PHR1重组蛋白在体外与催化亚基SnRK1alpha1和SnRK1alpha2相互作用。双分子荧光互补（BiFC）实验证实了PHR1与SnRK1alpha1在细胞质和细胞核中的体内相互作用。磷酸化残基分析表明，在S11位点存在一个含有SnRK1基序的磷酸化位点，该残基的突变破坏了(32)P的掺入，提示其是一个主要磷酸化位点。电泳迁移率变动分析结果表明，PHR1与P1BS基序的结合不受磷酸化影响。重要的是，在拟南芥原生质体中的瞬时表达实验显示，与S11A突变体相比，PHR1活性降低，提示Ser11作为负调控磷酸化位点发挥作用。综合来看，这些发现表明PHR1在Ser11位点的磷酸化是控制PHR1介导的-Pi适应性反应的一种机制。
